QuestInfo.name: Assailant 2
QuestInfo.0: You were attacked by one of the Black Wings, an organization bent on reviving the Black Mage. Ask #b#p1012100##k what's going on.
QuestInfo.1: #p1012100# suspects the Black Wings spy on her from time to time, but this is the first time they've attacked. They must have wanted to take #bMistelteinn#k! Now that they've failed, they're probably on their way to #b#m101050000##k. You must get back and protect your home!
QuestInfo.2: You made it back in time to stop their attack. Thankfully, no one was hurt in the battle.

1.0: Your Highness! Athena Pierce told me you were attacked. Are you hurt?
1.1: Fortunately, Athena Pierce and I managed to hold off the Black Wings' attack on the village, but...it was close. Why are they attacking us?
1.2: We don't know enough about the outside world to really say what's happening. It's best if you discuss the situation with Athena Pierce. However, she has responsibilities beyond the village. I fear we can't rely on her forever...

yes.0: Young Athena Pierce, all grown up. Amazing.
